scope: Matched historical PR #264 task: identify plan target coverage across multiple same-context runs, compare adjacent selected-target changes, and summarize caller-declared per-target outcomes while preserving missing-receipt unknowns.
findings: Single-run attribution validates one plan, run, artifact list, and optional receipt. Applied independently, it preserves one-run bindings but does not produce cross-run target union/intersection, additions/removals, or per-target history in one output.
The repeated-step analyzer compares job and step names, outcomes, and timestamps across runs, but it does not read validation plans, selected target IDs, artifact inventories, or component receipts.
The current single-run timeline operation summarizes one run job/step intervals and does not compare target coverage.
The new component composes existing per-run attribution and adds target-set and caller-declared-result aggregation. It does not replace any existing tool.
No matched performance, cash-cost, billing, avoidable-work, or reliability comparison was conducted. Estimated cost and savings remain unknown.

unique_remaining_use_cases.maintenance.attribute_actions_validation: Bind one run to its plan, artifact inventory, optional receipt, and per-run timeline.
unique_remaining_use_cases.maintenance.compare_actions_repeated_ste: Compare repeated named jobs/steps, outcomes, and observed intervals across same-context run history.
unique_remaining_use_cases.maintenance.summarize_actions_step_timel: Summarize one Actions run job/step timeline.
unique_remaining_use_cases.maintenance.compare_actions_validation_t: Compare selected-target plan coverage and caller-declared receipt outcomes across same-context runs, marking absent receipt as unknown.

retirement_or_migration: No retirement or migration is supported; the compared tools retain distinct useful scopes.
limitations: Caller-supplied sources are unauthenticated by the tool.
Receipt target booleans are caller declarations, not official CI validation.
Repeated target sets do not establish redundancy or waste.
No billing, cost/savings, merge, or release claim.
